about: Exact words of the Lucid Admin Console. <name> marks a value filled in at run time; quotes are part of the words. 'page' is section 8.1 (compound rows split into <id>.<part>; lists keep the contract's order), 'sign' the signing side's words, 'people' the words the Meeting Hub and Remote Spokes relays answer people, 'dialogs' section 8.2 (second: a two-admin action, showing dialog.second with two-person control on and dialog.single with it off; button_single: its button with two-person control off), 'refusals' section 8.3 (the first words are the answer, later ones the alternates), 'mail' section 8.4 (\n a line break; every mail ends with mail.footer's body), 'relay' the relay's start and other words, 'labels' section 7, 'clean' the characters removed from untrusted text (inclusive code point ranges). Not page text: cli.* (the offline CLI and start log; cli.dev-license is the start log of a dev-license build, which accepts development-key licenses and is never signed or shipped, R4-H1) and python.test-only with python.test-only.seatclock (the start refusals of the Python reference relay and lucid-relay-seatclock-check for every publisher-signed license and a production state folder). In attention.clock-uncertain and mail.clock-uncertain, <n> is the hours left before the hold, counting downtime, never an absolute time (R4-M1, R5-L1); mail.clock-uncertain's <time> is when the time became uncertain.

page.help.overview: A summary of this relay and what needs an admin. Each card opens its page.
page.help.requests: Some changes need a signature that this relay never holds. The console sends them as requests, and they are done when the signing side does them.
page.help.approvals: With two-person control on, changes that lower security or take access away need a second admin. Each request lasts 24 hours.
page.help.seats: When more people use Meeting Hub than the license covers, the relay waits 14 days, then takes seats from the people picked here first, then from the newest. Relay admins always keep a seat, and no certificate is revoked.
page.help.two-person: When on, changes that lower security or take access away wait for a second admin. Recommended with three or more admins.
page.help.banner: Shown before sign-in. Each person accepts it once per session. Leave it empty for none.
page.help.aaguids: When this list has entries, only these models give admins and user managers their rights, and each must still have a FIPS certificate and hardware key protection in its metadata. An empty list allows every model that does.
page.help.aaguids.standard: These models count as approved security keys, even without a FIPS certificate in their metadata. Under the High profile that is not enough.
page.help.mds: Load a newer metadata file from the FIDO Alliance. The console checks its signature.
page.help.audit: Every change made here, who made it and when. Each entry is chained to the one before, so an exported copy shows any later edit.
page.help.blocks: A block stops this relay from serving a node or device for a while. It does not revoke the certificate; ask for a revocation for that.
page.help.security: These actions shut doors, so they work whatever the license says.
page.help.spokes-elsewhere: Pairing, taking a spoke out of service, tasks, kits and backups are done in the IDE's Remote Spokes panel or with lucid-spoke on that machine.
page.help.meet-signing: Approvals are signed in the Meeting Hub app by an admin's own device. The console sends the request; the app shows it under Admin Console requests.
page.help.meet-policies: Policies are signed in the Meeting Hub app.
page.help.id1: Verify and approve in the Meeting Hub app. This list is the relay's copy and is not verified here.

body: They can invite and suspend viewers and user managers, pick who gives up a seat, and see people lists. They change no settings.

user-manager-viewer.title: Make <email> a viewer?

body: They can invite viewers and user managers, suspend them, pick who gives up a seat, and see people lists. The link works once, for 24 hours; pass it on yourself.

body: The old link stops working now. The new one works once, for 24 hours.

license.note: The Now line only when a license is installed. Then, on both products, each 'both' line that applies (R42-1: 'stopped' while service is stopped; R42-2: 'grace' when the token's grace is longer than 2 days). Then the product's lines (R3-L4): 'spokes' only on a Remote Spokes relay when the new license has a new ID; on a Meeting Hub relay each 'meet' group that applies, one sentence from each group.

mail.footer.body: This message was sent by the Lucid Admin Console at <host>. It never asks for your password or a code.

mail.invite.subject: Your invite to the Lucid Admin Console at <host>
mail.invite.body:
<inviter> invited you to the Lucid Admin Console at <host> as a viewer.

Set up how you sign in here. The link works once, until <time>:
<link>

If you did not expect this, ignore this email.

mail.reset-password.subject: Reset your Lucid Admin Console password
mail.reset-password.body:
Someone asked to reset the password of <email> on the Lucid Admin Console at <host>.

Choose a new password here. The link works once, until <time>:
<link>

Your authenticator app or passkey stays the same. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

mail.test.subject: Test email from the Lucid Admin Console
mail.test.body: This is a test from the Lucid Admin Console at <host>. Email works.

mail.seats-over.subject: Meeting Hub on <host>: <seated> people, <users> seats
mail.seats-over.body:
<seated> people use Meeting Hub on <host>, and the license covers <users>.

On <date> (day 14), the relay takes seats from <n> people: first those an admin picked, then the newest. Relay admins keep their seats, and no certificate is revoked.

To keep everyone, request more seats: <console>#/meet/seats
To choose who gives up a seat, use the same page.

mail.seats-request.subject: Meeting Hub seat request, license <license id>
mail.seats-request.body:
Organization: <org>
License ID: <license id>
Product: Meeting Hub
Seats in the license: <users>
Seats in use: <seated>
Seats wanted: <wanted>
Admin: <name> <email>
Relay: <host>
Sent from the Lucid Admin Console on <time>.

mail.unseated.subject: Your Meeting Hub seat
mail.unseated.body:
Your organization's Meeting Hub license on <host> has fewer seats than people, so your seat was taken on <date>. Meeting Hub does not work for you until a seat is free. Ask your admin.

Your devices stay enrolled. When a seat frees up, you get it back without doing anything.

mail.reseated.subject: Your Meeting Hub seat is back
mail.reseated.body: A Meeting Hub seat on <host> is yours again. Meeting Hub works for you now.

mail.upgrade-period.subject: Meeting Hub on <host> needs a license by <date and time>
mail.upgrade-period.body:
This Meeting Hub relay was upgraded and has no license. Service stops on <date and time> unless a Meeting Hub license is installed.

Install one in the Admin Console: <console>#/meet/license

mail.license-expiring.subject: <product> license on <host> ends in <n> days
mail.license-expiring.body:
The <product> license of this relay ends on <date> (ID <license id>). Install a new license before then, or the relay stops serving people after at most 2 grace days.

Install a license: <console>#/<section>/license

mail.license-grace.subject: <product> on <host>: service stops on <date and time>
mail.license-grace.body:
The <product> license of this relay ended on <date> (ID <license id>). Service stops on <date and time> unless a new license is installed.

Install a license: <console>#/<section>/license

mail.license-stopped.subject: <product> on <host> has stopped serving people
mail.license-stopped.body:
This relay stopped serving people on <date and time> because its <product> license is not active (<why>). The Admin Console still works.

Install a license to turn service back on: <console>#/<section>/license

mail.clock-uncertain.subject: Meeting Hub on <host>: confirm the relay's time
mail.clock-uncertain.body:
The relay's clock jumped or was off for more than a day on <time>, so seat deadlines are on hold. If no admin confirms the time within <n> hours, people over the license are held without service until someone does. Time the relay is stopped counts too.

Confirm it here: <console>#/admins/settings/security

mail.break-glass.subject: Break-glass sign-in on <host>
mail.break-glass.body:
The break-glass account <email> signed in to the Lucid Admin Console at <host> on <time> from <address>.

If this was not planned, sign in now, check the audit log, and end its sessions.

mail.attention.subject: Lucid Admin Console at <host>: something needs your attention
mail.attention.body:
<attention words>

Open: <console><go>

You get this because you chose it in Your account, Email me about.

relay.start.fronts-needed: the console behind a TLS front needs --console-trusted-fronts (the front's addresses)
relay.start.fronts-wide: a trusted front range of <range> lets every host in it name the client; list only the front's addresses
relay.start.first-admin-needed: the console needs --console-first-admin <email> until its first admin signs in
relay.start.meet.console-public-ip: passkeys need a DNS name: set console_public to a host name
relay.start.meet.console-public-shared: the Admin Console needs a host name of its own: console_public may not share a host name with the relay or the guest page
relay.start.meet.console-cert: console_cert must be a certificate browsers trust for <host>, not one from the Meet CA
relay.start.meet.console-sources: set console_sources to the networks admins use, for example the VPN's range
relay.start.meet.console-first-admin: set console_first_admin to the relay admin who signs in first
relay.start.meet.console-profile: console_profile must be standard or high
relay.license.for-meet: this license is for Meeting Hub, not Remote Spokes
relay.license.for-spokes: this license is for Remote Spokes, not Meeting Hub
relay.license.no-root: this relay's client_ca has no root certificate
relay.license.old-verifier: malformed license: root must be an org root node id (n_...)
relay.block.node: this node is blocked on this relay by its admins
relay.block.device: this device is blocked on this relay by its admins
relay.meet.console-off: The Admin Console is turned off on this relay. Set console_port in relay.json.
relay.meet.console-python: The Admin Console needs the Rust relay (lucid-relay meet).
